edges.mechanism: Tributyrin is a butyrate prodrug with the same active moiety; combining duplicates butyrate exposure without evidence of added benefit.
edges.evidence: Tributyrin PK/safety studies; no combination study

edges.mechanism: Butyrogenic fibre raises colonic butyrate; sodium butyrate plus inulin lowered fasting glucose and waist-to-hip ratio (within-group) and raised GLP-1 vs placebo in T2D.
edges.evidence: Four-arm RCT in T2D (n=60, 45 days) plus fibre MA; low certainty

edges.mechanism: GOS is bifidogenic; one crossover RCT (16 g/d) reduced butyrate-producing Ruminococcus and raised fasting glucose, while a GOS-containing blend increased butyrate producers. Net effect on butyrate inconsistent.
edges.evidence: Two small RCTs; very low certainty

edges.mechanism: Acarbose increases starch reaching the colon, raising faecal butyrate (22-28 vs 18-19 mol/100 mol) and serum butyrate (4.2 vs 2.6 uM); additive butyrate exposure with supplemental butyrate.
edges.evidence: Two RCTs of acarbose; no combination study

edges.mechanism: Sodium butyrate improved CGM time-in-tight-range/HbA1c in some T2D RCTs; metformin enriches microbial butanoate pathways. Possible small additive glucose lowering.
edges.evidence: RCTs of butyrate in T2D; observational/pilot metformin microbiome data; no combination study

edges.mechanism: Berberine RCTs show depletion of butyrate-producing taxa alongside glucose/lipid improvements; may oppose endogenous butyrate production while adding glucose lowering.
edges.evidence: SR of 7 RCTs (microbiome outcomes); hypothesis-generating

edges.mechanism: Riboflavin 50-100 mg/d increased faecal butyrate production without major microbiota shifts.
edges.evidence: Single RCT (RIBOGUT); very low certainty

edges.mechanism: Fish oil plus soluble fibre lowered Roseburia butyrate-kinase gene abundance vs comparator, without changing faecal butyrate.
edges.evidence: Crossover RCT (n=30); clinical relevance unknown

edges.mechanism: Oral butyrate 4 g/d plus mesalazine gave greater improvement from baseline than mesalazine alone; MSB add-on to standard UC therapy improved remission.
edges.evidence: Pilot RCT (n=30) and multicentre RCT (n=98); low certainty

edges.mechanism: Oral sodium butyrate raised daytime systolic BP +9.63 mmHg and diastolic +5.08 mmHg over 4 weeks in hypertension (medication withdrawn); may counteract BP control.
edges.evidence: Single RCT (n=23) plus SR finding inconsistent direct effects

edges.mechanism: Sodium butyrate reduced HbA1c/HOMA-IR or improved CGM metrics in some T2D trials; additive glucose lowering possible but small and inconsistent.
edges.evidence: Small RCTs; one 6-week RCT without between-group glycemic effect

edges.mechanism: Both valproic acid and butyrate are HDAC inhibitors; additive HDAC inhibition (including embryotoxicity) is theoretical.
edges.evidence: Mechanistic reviews only; no clinical interaction study

edges.mechanism: Butyrate/tributyrin act via HDAC inhibition and epigenetic modulation; overlapping pharmacology with drugs such as vorinostat is theoretical.
edges.evidence: Mechanistic reviews; no clinical interaction study

edges.mechanism: SCFA (propionate + butyrate) supplementation in Parkinson's disease coincided with clinically relevant reductions in levodopa medication.
edges.evidence: RCT (n=72) without placebo-only arm; open-label tributyrin study

edges.mechanism: Antibiotics deplete commensal bacteria and disrupt the barrier; butyrate supplementation is proposed to mitigate antibiotic-induced dysbiosis.
edges.evidence: Narrative review; no human RCT

edges.mechanism: Oral sodium butyrate increased 24-h daytime BP in hypertensive adults; colon-targeted enema lowered BP acutely; direct effects inconsistent.
edges.evidence: RCT (n=23), crossover (n=20), SR

edges.mechanism: No human data; HDAC inhibitors including sodium butyrate induce congenital malformations in experimental embryo studies; label advises consulting a practitioner.
edges.evidence: Review of experimental teratology; product label

edges.mechanism: Adjunct only: oral/microencapsulated butyrate may aid remission in adult UC/CD, but showed no benefit in pediatric IBD.
edges.evidence: RCTs and SRs; low certainty

edges.mechanism: The liver takes up absorbed butyrate; a participant with pre-existing liver impairment discontinued sustained-release calcium butyrate.
edges.evidence: Mechanistic human flux study; single dropout in RCT

edges.mechanism: True physiological decrease with butyrate in UC/IBD trials; interpret disease-activity markers accordingly.
edges.evidence: RCTs

edges.mechanism: Oral butyrate alters plasma and faecal SCFA profiles (faecal butyrate sometimes unchanged), so stool SCFA tests during supplementation may not reflect endogenous production.
edges.evidence: RCTs measuring SCFAs

edges.mechanism: Microencapsulated sodium butyrate reduced the frequency of positive lactulose hydrogen breath tests in T2D with IBS.
edges.evidence: Single RCT (n=52)
